title: Make the 118-effect dropdown findable — WITHOUT bricking every Counter card
goal: ONPLAY_TYPES (101405-101696) has 118 entries; ONPLAY_TYPE_GROUPS (101702-101712) has 10 groups covering 112, with exactly 6 ungrouped (purityPact, buffPerCard, mirrorWard, soulSwap, tributeRite, stillnessSeal) swept into '🔧 Other' by _onplayTypeOptgroups (101719). Group the 6, add a type-to-filter and a one-line inline explanation of the selected effect, at all 11 call sites INCLUDING the spell select at 146471 and the trap select — 146471 is NOT like the others: it prepends nine hand-written classics (_CLASSIC_SPELL_FX, 118900) then appends the grouped 118, and a spell's or trap's whole body IS that dropdown, so they are in scope, not 'at minimum'. Ungrouped is not cosmetic: an id in no group is invisible to _counterScopeOk (159468) so a scoped Counter can never answer it. COPY THE HOUSE PATTERN, do not invent a fourth: buildPassiveOpts at 145808 with _passiveCat at 145801 already buckets ~187 PASSIVES, emits `<optgroup label="… (n)">` with counts, keeps 'none' outside the groups and appends an '◇ Other' bucket. THE LABEL STRINGS ARE PERSISTED LIVE DATA. The contract comment at 159450 is explicit: `card.counterScope = ['🃏 Cards & Hand', '⚰️ Graveyard & Void']  // group labels`, matched by literal string at 159470 (`scope.indexOf(g.label) < 0`) and FAILING CLOSED at 159473 (`return false`). Renaming or splitting a group silently narrows or empties every already-authored Counter card's scope and the counter simply refuses everything, with no error.
bar: THE LABEL FREEZE IS THE PRIMARY BAR. The 10 existing group label strings are byte-identical to HEAD (script-diffed), and grouping the 6 orphans is done by ADDING them to existing groups or by adding NEW groups — never by renaming or splitting an existing one. If any existing label must change, the piece ships a counterScope migration over Forge.customCards AND asserts: for every card carrying a counterScope, _counterScopeOk returns the SAME answer as HEAD for the same action (enumerate every card × every ONPLAY_TYPES id and diff the boolean matrix against HEAD's). REGISTRY: zero ungrouped ids (HEAD has exactly 6 — the critic prints both), no id in two groups (HEAD has 0 duplicates, so this is a CONTROL not a bar), and _counterScopeOk resolves a group for every id. FINDABILITY, with thresholds so 'size for scanning' is not prose: no optgroup holds more than 12 options (HEAD's '⚰️ Graveyard & Void' holds 19); typing 'discard' into the filter leaves only options whose label matches and clearing restores all 118; selecting an effect renders its meaning in the DOM with no modal, and the rendered text EQUALS the effect's description string from the registry (DOM-asserted, not eyeballed). SCOPE: the spell select at 146471 and the trap select get the same filter and inline explanation, with the nine classics still listed and still ahead of the groups. `node _duel_smoke.mjs` ALL PASS — it text-slices `const ONPLAY_TYPES = [` to the first line-start `];` (29-32) and asserts exact needs.join() strings per effect (55), so a reformatted literal makes it THROW, which _checkall reports as CRASH not a readable failure.

title: A section index that reflects what the card actually contains
goal: The sticky chip bar at 148758-148765 (bound 150620-150643) offers five chips — identity, kind, obtain, effects, evolve — for an editor with five sections plus four sub-drawers plus the nine ability drawers the runtime split produces at 150550. Name those drawers so an author jumps to 'On Attack' or 'Aura' directly, and show per-section how many fields the author has FILLED. Also stop emitting fx-obtain (148893) entirely: it contains only craftCostBlock, which is `''` at 146747 with a single use at 148896 — a dead section surviving only because the sweep at 150611 hides it, which will resurrect the moment anyone adds a field there. Deleting it has two consequences the old plan missed: the section ordinals are HARDCODED (`1` at 148768, 2 at 148869, 3 at 148894, 4 at 148901, 5 at 148923), so removal leaves the editor reading 1,2,4,5; and the chip key is string-concatenated onto 'fx-' at 150620/150627, so a stale key breaks its chip with NO console error.
bar: `fx-obtain` appears ZERO times in the string renderCardEditor() returns (HEAD has it), and the remaining `fx-sum-n` values are contiguous 1..N. On a card with an aura and an on-kill ability, the nav lists both drawers by name and clicking each yields document.getElementById('fx-'+key).open === true AND a changed getBoundingClientRect().top. FILLED IS DEFINED, not left to the builder: a field counts as filled when its value differs from the value renderCardEditor emits for that field on an EMPTY draft (App.editingCardId='NEW') — the driver computes the empty-draft baseline itself and the badge must equal that computed count for three seeded cards. The badge next to Effects increments when an effect is set and returns to its baseline when cleared. CROSS-CARD STATE, which the old bar could not detect: App._fxOpen (133951) accumulates section ids across cards and is never cleared, so the driver must open card A, expand two sections, open card B, and assert no chip claims a section that is hidden on B. PINNED REGRESSIONS: `node .gauntlet/drive-scroll-keep.mjs` regex-tests the raw HTML for /id="fx-effects" open/, /id="fx-kind">/ and the ABSENCE of / open>/ (126-134); run-ai-gate's U4 block (597-612) counts exact source markers including ["_fxOpen('fx-effects')", 1]; and `node _cardcraft_smoke.mjs` pins the card-crafting deletion guard while requiring item crafting to survive — run it explicitly, it is what fx-obtain's emptiness comes from.

title: Grouped, self-explaining status pickers — all EIGHT of them
goal: The previous plan named five status selects and MISSED the three that matter most for day-to-day authoring. `const statusList = ['','strong','weak','poison','burn','bleed','stun','slow','frozen','sleep','confusion','paralysis','dispel','stumble','assisted']` at 146473 is FOURTEEN ids hardcoded, and it feeds THREE selects: spellStatusOpts (146474 → #ed-spell-status at 146510), _pcStOpts (146501 → #ed-persist-status-id at 146558) and trapStatusOpts (146607 → #ed-trap-status at 146615). STATUS_EFFECTS (39741-39941) has 60 entries, so 46 statuses are simply unauthorable on spells and traps — the two card types where statuses actually get authored. All eight pickers are in scope: those three plus the move editor's #mv-status and #mv-status2 (152435-152442 off STATUS_ORDER at 152406-152418), the on-play primary (146781), the on-Kalon-transform one (146203) and the extras via _statOptsFor (147244). A field-derived taxonomy already exists with player-facing hints: the Book of Knowledge grouper at 248446-248488 (dot/control/debuff/buff + ✨ Other) plus statusCard's mechanical summary at 248506 ('3-6 dmg/turn', '+4 DEF', 'cannot act'). Hoist both into one shared helper shaped like buildPassiveOpts (145808) and use it everywhere.
bar: COVERAGE, which is the whole point: every one of the 60 STATUS_EFFECTS ids appears exactly once across the optgroups of each of the EIGHT rewritten pickers — script-checked against the lifted literal, with the count printed per picker (HEAD prints 14 for the three spell/trap/persist selects; that delta is the piece). The '— None —' option is asserted separately as a value-'' option OUTSIDE the registry set, since the on-play select filters st.id !== 'none' (146782) against a registry that has no 'none' row. EXPLANATION, DOM-asserted not eyeballed: selecting `siphoned` renders text in the DOM whose content EQUALS STATUS_EFFECTS.siphoned.desc concatenated with the mechanical summary string the 248506 helper produces for it, with no modal opened (assert no .modal in the DOM after the change event). TWO BEHAVIOURS THAT MUST NOT CONVERGE: #mv-status still lists knockback and grappleHook and still translates them to move.knockback / move.pull on save (the virtual-primary-status synthesis at 152431-152433 — dropping them breaks authoring of every knockback move), while the Book of Knowledge still EXCLUDES them and its tab still counts 58 (248691-248694). The Codex's own rendering is unchanged (screenshot A/B via harness worktree). `node _duel_smoke.mjs` ALL PASS — it text-slices the STATUS_EFFECTS literal and validates applyStatus ids against it. `node _forgeids_smoke.mjs` half B ALL-IDENTICAL: widening a status list must not change any saved card.

title: The spell and trap bodies — the two card types that are nothing but dropdowns
goal: A spell's and a trap's entire authored body is the type-rules block: for a spell, #ed-spell-effect + amount + target + cast range + status + subtype + fusion-Kalon picker + the whole persistent-enchantment sub-block (146537-146570: aura stat/target, dot, heal, status id/target, energy regen), and for a trap the parallel block ending at #ed-trap-status (146615). These render as one flat run of .editor-field with no sub-grouping, no gating and no explanation, and the persistent-enchantment fields show for every spell whether or not `persistent` is set. Group them, gate the persistent sub-block on the persistent toggle and the fusion-Kalon picker on subtype==='polycreation' (the same live-gating discipline as piece 4: hidden in the DOM, still .editor-field, sweep re-run on change), and carry piece 6's filter + inline explanation and piece 8's grouped status picker into both bodies.
bar: With type='spell' and persistent OFF, zero fields of the persistent sub-block are visible and ALL of them are still in the DOM (assert both: querySelectorAll count unchanged, offsetParent-visible count zero) — the DOM half is what protects _pcPersistDur / _pcPersistDrw / the energy-regen number from num()'s literal fallbacks. Toggling persistent ON reveals exactly the sub-block's fields and nothing else. With subtype != 'polycreation' the fusion-Kalon picker is hidden and in the DOM. The visible .editor-field count for a plain damage spell drops >= 40% versus HEAD at the same forced-open state, with the piece-3 legibility floor still satisfied. NO SECTION GOES EMPTY-BUT-VISIBLE for any (type × effect × persistent × subtype) combination the driver enumerates. THE GATE: `node _forgeids_smoke.mjs` half B stays ALL-IDENTICAL over every spell and trap in Forge.customCards — a conditionally-rendered persistent block would silently rewrite persistDuration to its fallback on the next save of any spell. `node _duel_smoke.mjs` ALL PASS (it validates _CLASSIC_SPELL_FX ids at 174012/174038).
